config.video_studio.enabled_help: Turns on the Video Studio app in the virtual desktop. FFmpeg and FFprobe must be installed on the server.
config.video_studio.readonly_help: Projects can be viewed but not changed or exported.
config.video_studio.ffmpeg_help: Path to the FFmpeg executable. Leave empty to find FFmpeg through the system PATH.
config.video_studio.asset_limit_help: Largest allowed single media file in megabytes (default 4096).
config.video_studio.project_limit_help: Total size of all files in one project in megabytes (default 16384).
config.video_studio.timeout_help: Longest time for rendering a video in seconds, then it is aborted (30 to 14400, default 7200).
config.video_studio.hardware_device_help: Render device of the graphics card, for example /dev/dri/renderD128 on Linux. Empty = automatic.
config.retro_games.enabled_help: Turns on the Retro Games app in the virtual desktop. The games run in the archive.org emulator and need internet access.
config.retro_games.agent_access_help: The agent may search for games and start them in the desktop.
